sources.title: Rotor Performance of an Isolated Full-Scale XV-15 Tiltrotor in Helicopter Mode
sources.access: public PDF downloaded and SHA-256 recorded
sources.claims_supported: Isolated rotor hover and low-speed helicopter-mode performance; Mtip=0.691, first-harmonic flapping trimmed near zero
sources.reliability_notes: Read thrust/torque normalization, hub tare and shaft angle; digitized plots are not original samples

sources.title: Rotor Design Options for Improving XV-15 Whirl-Flutter Stability Margins
sources.access: public PDF downloaded and SHA-256 recorded
sources.claims_supported: Appendix A provides CAMRAD II model inputs for geometry and aerodynamic tables
sources.reliability_notes: Engineering model includes modifications to aircraft; check original metal blade versus ATB and spanwise airfoil/Mach tables before using

sources.title: Experimental and analytical studies of a model helicopter rotor in hover
sources.access: public PDF downloaded and SHA-256 recorded
sources.claims_supported: Blade pressure and tip-vortex surveys across tip Mach numbers
sources.reliability_notes: Blade-element model can compare integrated sectional loads, not chordwise pressure or vortex position; start at subsonic conditions

sources.title: UIUC Propeller Database Volume 1
sources.source_type: original experimental text data and approximate geometry
sources.access: public page and data links verified
sources.claims_supported: Static RPM sweeps and axial advance-ratio sweeps; some propeller geometries available
sources.reliability_notes: Use corrected online data rather than older thesis tables; confirm section airfoils and Reynolds dependence separately; these are propellers, not full helicopter rotors

sources.title: A mathematical model of the UH-60 helicopter
sources.access: public PDF downloaded and SHA-256 recorded
sources.claims_supported: Configuration parameters, fuselage, canted tail rotor and stabilator equations; trim and derivatives
sources.reliability_notes: Report validation described as comparison with another mathematical model; do not label these outputs flight measurements

sources.title: UH-60 Airloads Flight Project and Wind Tunnel Test Summary
sources.source_type: original test program and report index
sources.access: public program pages verified; complete raw database access unconfirmed
sources.claims_supported: Blade airloads, structural loads, controls, aircraft states; flight and wind-tunnel conditions
sources.reliability_notes: Reports are open; do not assume TRENDSClient time-history database is anonymous public download; match counter, calibration and corrections
sources.use_in_report: Forward flight and later aircraft validation

sources.title: Rotor/wing aerodynamic interactions in hover
sources.source_type: original experiment and semi-empirical method / PDF
sources.access: public PDF downloaded and SHA-256 recorded
sources.claims_supported: Wing download, surface pressures, rotor performance and downwash; geometry variations
sources.reliability_notes: Future interference-module validation; citing a download formula does not reproduce the experiment

sources.title: Aerodynamics of Wings in Tandem at Low Reynolds Numbers
sources.publisher: Auburn University / Syed Hassan Raza Shah
sources.access: public thesis page and PDF link verified
sources.claims_supported: NACA0012 isolated and tandem-wing forces/moments at Re=20000 and 100000
sources.reliability_notes: Match chapter-specific geometry, axes, Reynolds number and angles; unpowered wing data do not validate powered rotor-wing coupling
sources.use_in_report: Reference workflow and future wing interference

sources.title: Time and frequency-domain identification and verification of BO-105 dynamic models
sources.access: indexed; NTRS has no downloadable full text
sources.reliability_notes: Not a ready-to-run dataset; full paper, matrices and condition definitions still needed

sources.title: Effects of Independent Variation of Mach and Reynolds Numbers on the Low-Speed Aerodynamic Characteristics of the NACA 0012 Airfoil Section
sources.access: public PDF downloaded; Tables I and VII visually checked
sources.claims_supported: NACA0012 measured CL/CD, Re=2e6 and M=0.15, free/fixed transition subsets
sources.reliability_notes: Use table-specific Re/M, not the broad web abstract range. PG-generated Mach nodes and reflected negative-alpha extensions are model assumptions.
sources.use_in_report: Caradonna–Tung airfoil input and transition sensitivity
